Four shards are now over the limit. The buildings verify was not re-run after step 6b; its detail lists up to four names, so a re-run should name all four. The three tiles already carried labels from an earlier pass before this run (9589324 bytes, against 9463545 in /home/user/hail-b5/out/combined/store, which has no labels). The site copy /home/user/hail-b5/out/b6/site/hail/b matches the pre-run sizes. Choosing a fix (re-split these tiles with label bytes counted, or revisit the 250000 limit in D26) is for the owner. Nothing was changed. Evidence: /home/user/hail-b5/out/b6/build/store-check/step11-shard-compare.log and step12-site-vs-post.log

2. Basemap2 is partial. Detailed water at zoom 13 and up is missing for 52 of 54 areas. The P2 cache has no copy of nhd_large_areas (966 of 974 files missing) or nhd_large_lines (1092 of 1135). The index reports tiles_built 20 of 4597 tiles in coverage. This check cannot refill the cache without network access. Until the cache is refilled and the build rerun, the About page must not credit those outlines.

3. The terrain re-fetch was not run. --offline skipped the 10-tile sample (checked 0), so tile pixels were not compared with the service. The 20 local checks pass. An online verify is still needed.

5. The buildings verify ran without --gdb-zip and --counties-zip, so the whole-part recompute and the per-county counts were not checked.

6. Offline status: the terrain, basemap2, landmarks and history builds reported zero requests. The verifies and the labels commands have no --offline switch and read only the store or the cache. No HTTP client import was found in buildings.py, labels.py, history_layers.py, basemap2.py, hail.py, addresses.py or stations.py. landmarks.py imports only urllib.parse.urlencode.
